query: Which governance model (public release, controlled-access, federated) best balances reproducibility and regulatory/consent constraints, and how to de-identify while preserving ECG/respiratory traces?

response.query: Which governance model (public release, controlled-access, federated) best balances reproducibility and regulatory/consent constraints, and how to de-identify while preserving ECG/respiratory traces?
response.answer: Federated governance best balances reproducibility and regulatory/consent constraints. De-identify ECG/respiratory traces using techniques like data masking and aggregation to preserve data utility.
